audit_log_actor_check.name: audit_log_actor_check
audit_log_actor_check.value: ("audit_log"."actor_type" = 'user' AND "audit_log"."actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("audit_log"."actor_type" = 'system' AND "audit_log"."actor_user_id" IS NULL)

trailing_stops_trail_check.name: trailing_stops_trail_check
trailing_stops_trail_check.value: ("trailing_stops"."trail_unit" = 'AMOUNT' AND "trailing_stops"."trail_amount" > 0 AND "trailing_stops"."trail_basis_points" IS NULL) OR ("trailing_stops"."trail_unit" = 'PERCENT' AND "trailing_stops"."trail_basis_points" > 0 AND "trailing_stops"."trail_amount" IS NULL)

trailing_stops_prices_check.name: trailing_stops_prices_check
trailing_stops_prices_check.value: ("trailing_stops"."activation_price" IS NULL OR "trailing_stops"."activation_price" > 0) AND ("trailing_stops"."stop_price" IS NULL OR "trailing_stops"."stop_price" > 0) AND ("trailing_stops"."watermark_price" IS NULL OR "trailing_stops"."watermark_price" >= 0) AND ("trailing_stops"."exit_limit_offset" IS NULL OR "trailing_stops"."exit_limit_offset" >= 0)

users_mobile_check.name: users_mobile_check
users_mobile_check.value: "users"."purged_at" IS NOT NULL OR ("users"."mobile_enc" IS NOT NULL AND "users"."mobile_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "users"."mobile_last4" IS NOT NULL)
